title: Hammurabi I of Yamhad
summary: Ruler listed in CFAH-16 Table 1 (Neighbours of Israel (11th century BC)).
description: Ruler of Neighbours of Israel (11th century BC). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-16 (Table 1, "Chronology of Neighboring Kings to Israel in the 11th Century"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.note: Row "Hammurabi I (Hamath-Yamhad)" of Table 1 (Neighbours of Israel (11th century BC)).
